outcome: immune system parameters (IgA, IgG, absolute lymphocytosis, active T-lymphocytes, pathological T-helper levels, T-cytotoxic)
cohort: The study included 120 children conceived by ART and 132 naturally conceived children, all under the age of five.
finding: ART-conceived children showed significantly altered immunogram parameters, including lower IgA and IgG, absolute lymphocytosis, and higher levels of active T-lymphocytes and pathological T-helper cells compared to naturally conceived children, with these impacts persisting after controlling for confounders.
cross-section timing: Children were assessed at a single point in time, anytime before reaching five years of age.
